title: Prove2Me formalization contributions by Alexander Richard Towell: a versioned proof and evidence archive

owner.source_commit_scope: Frozen collection source cutoff; detailed research lifecycle remains private.

claim: Durable collection snapshot preserving exact accepted Lean proofs, full-type audits, platform receipts, source and predecessor attribution, and human/AI roles independently of Prove2Me. No new mathematics or human peer review claimed.
human_role: Alexander Richard Towell directs and stewards the work; per-result roles are retained from the ledger, without inferring independent human proof review.

ai_assistance.role: Substantial formalization, verification, submission, documentation and collection preparation. Models not established by records remain unknown.
Shared-repository organization and bulk-archive planning, as documented by the 22 October handoff. Not represented as authorship or review of these mathematical proofs.

predecessor_credit: Original mathematics, platform statements and actual reused proof sources retain per-result and per-source attribution. Existing focused DOI families remain canonical and are linked from the collection.
license: Apache-2.0 for included material with preserved source notices; unresolved dependency bytes excluded.
limitations: Three accepted targets are metadata-only because six transitive platform dependency files lack confirmed redistribution evidence.
Local conditional or unsubmitted research, private operational logs and full conversations are outside this edition.
Pinned Lean/Mathlib caches were reused; rebuilding these caches from source was not tested.

publication.published_at_basis: Timestamp from the first successful publish response; public metadata publication_date is separately retained.
publication.readiness: All three public downloads match; all 3034 packet files and extracted integrity verified. Exact proof/audit/evidence bytes are those of the complete 354-target, 267-module replay.
publication.note: The packet records DOI reservation at assembly; the dated public-download receipt establishes publication. Original platform and focused-publication dates remain separate.

public_disclosures.scope: Per-target original acceptance dates remain in collection.json and selected receipts; edition publication is a separate event.
